t: Four statements that leave nothing outside
a: أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَىْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَىْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَىْءٌ
p: Aʿūdhu bika min sharri kulli dhī sharrin anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatih. Anta-l-awwalu fa-laysa qablaka shayʾ, wa anta-l-ākhiru fa-laysa baʿdaka shayʾ, wa anta-ẓ-ẓāhiru fa-laysa fawqaka shayʾ
m: I seek refuge in You from the evil of every evil thing whose forelock You hold. You are the First, so there is nothing before You. You are the Last, so there is nothing after You. You are the Outermost, so there is nothing above You.
